title: Concept: Dependency version written as a moving token
description: pom.xml declares a dependency version of `LATEST` or `RELEASE`, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: The declaration leaves version choice to a resolver run, so a release published after this review is taken without a new decision. This rule reads a dependency version of `LATEST` or `RELEASE`.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through pom.xml (maven).
risk: The declaration leaves version choice to a resolver run, so a release published after this review is taken without a new decision. This rule reads a dependency version of `LATEST` or `RELEASE`.
